description: This file contains platform-specific functions for checking, upgrading, and copying configurations of different hardware boards related to the OpenWRT project, specifically tailored for the apm821xx target.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image for the current board, calling specific functions based on board type.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade tailored to specific boards.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data for specific boards.
